To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) for a given LOP and transmission distance, the best performance is achieved by FLC, and (ii) at very high LOP (e.g., ≥2 dBm), Volterra-NLE outperforms FLC.
MLC is an effective blind NLE method that can tackle the nonlinearities in coherent optical OFDM systems.
MLC algorithms can be used for blind NLE of coherent multicarrier systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and experimental verification of MLC-based NLE algorithms for coherent optical multicarrier signals.
the development and experimental demonstration of MLC algorithms in single- and multichannel coherent OFDM signals for blind NLE of fiber-induced nonlinearities.
the design of an effective and simple NLE technique for single- and multichannel coherent OFDM signals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed MLC algorithms can be considered as the best equalization candidates for coherent optical OFDM systems.
MLC algorithms are a viable alternative for Volterra-NLE.
the MLC algorithms are more suitable than the deterministic Volterra-based nonlinear equalization in optical communications, especially for high-level modulation formats.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MLC algorithms can be a viable alternative to the deterministic Volerra-NLE in the context of coherent multicarrier transmission systems.
MLC is more effective than Volterra-based NLE in compensating the nonlinearities for low- and moderate-level modulation formats.
MLC can tackle nonlinearities with the same performance as Volterra-NLE but without the need to know the order of the nonlinear system and without the need for any prior training.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MLC can provide a promising alternative to the conventional Volterra-NLE for nonlinear equalization in coherent optical communications.
MLC algorithms can be used as an effective alternative to deterministic Volterra analysis for blind NLE in single- and multichannel coherent OFDM signals.
MLC algorithms can be employed for nonlinear equalization of optical multicarrier systems.
